---
title: Home
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        -
          - 'nav.navbar[aria-label="Main"]'
          - 'nav#quarto-sidebar[aria-label="Section"]'
          - 'nav.quarto-secondary-nav[aria-label="Secondary"]'
          - 'nav#TOC[role="doc-toc"][aria-labelledby="toc-title"]'
        -
          - 'nav[aria-label="breadcrumb"]'
---

Every `nav` landmark on a website page gets a distinct, localizable label (#14376).
The sidebar says "Section" because this site also has a navbar. Labels do not
include the word "navigation": screen readers announce the role after the label.

## A heading

Content so the TOC renders.
